title: Did you know? The quickest strikes on the biggest stage

slides.context: Hakan Şükür scored after eleven seconds for Turkey in 2002, the *quickest* strike at this level. [VERIFY]
Václav Mašek's sixteen-second goal in 1962 stood as the *standard* for four decades. [VERIFY]
Bryan Robson struck after twenty-seven seconds against France in 1982, his country's *fastest*. [VERIFY]

slides.note: Three blinks. One ball already in the net. ...under protest.
